description.value: Mantles Restaurant & Lounge is the signature dining venue at the Sun Peaks Grand Hotel, a four-season mountain resort in British Columbia's Thompson-Okanagan region. The kitchen champions a 'Mountain Wellness' philosophy, building a modern menu around locally sourced ingredients with broad dietary accommodation. Cyclists passing through Sun Peaks can grab takeaway to fuel their next ride, or settle in for a full sit-down meal featuring BC wines and cocktails crafted with local flavours.

address.value: 3240 Village Way, Sun Peaks, BC V0E 5N0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for Sun Peaks Grand confirms Mantles Restaurant & Lounge is an active, open restaurant at 3240 Village Way, Sun Peaks. The OSM name contains two typos ('Manties' and 'Restuarant') which the website corrects; per rule 12 I use the website value and flag the discrepancy. Takeout and dietary accommodations (GF, nut-free, dairy-free) are explicitly stated; bike parking, washrooms, and most other amenities are not mentioned in the website content.
concerns: OSM name 'Manties Restuarant & Lounge' contains two typos: 'Manties' should be 'Mantles' and 'Restuarant' should be 'Restaurant' — corrected to website value 'Mantles Restaurant & Lounge'.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant at a well-known BC mountain resort. Takeout service makes it directly useful to touring cyclists.
